notes: Snapshot of rosters. Age is calculated from birthDate automatically. Stats are 1-150 ratings (see README for how each sport maps). 'comp' is a Gen 1 (#1-151) Pokemon comparison shown only after the puzzle ends.

athletes.name: Shohei Ohtani
athletes.bio: It is gifted in more ways than seems fair. Rivals study it from every angle and still can't find a weakness.

comp.name: Mew
comp.why: Said to know every move. Pitches and hits at an MVP level.

comp.name: Starmie
